data.title: The visitor’s pass

memoryNodes.cue: Maya brought pictures of the centre.
The pass allows entry to the workshop.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 访客证允许进入实作室。

memoryNodes.cue: A student moves a trolley between the benches.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 学生在工作台之间移动推车。

data.situation:
A week after the open day, Maya and Jo took a coach to a nearby college. Jo had arranged a visit to an engineering workshop. At reception, Maya was carrying a folder of photographs from the centre. She put it down while the receptionist printed a visitor’s pass. The pass would let them through the workshop gate; it was not a travel ticket. Receptionist: Please wear your pass where we can see it. The workshop is after the glass doors.
Maya: Shall we wait here?
Receptionist: Dr Chen will come to meet you.
Through the doors, Maya noticed the movement of a trolley across the workshop floor. A student pushed it slowly between the benches.

readingBlocks.en: A week after the open day, Maya and Jo took a coach to a nearby college. Jo had arranged a visit to an engineering workshop. At reception, Maya was carrying a folder of photographs from the centre. She put it down while the receptionist printed a visitor’s pass. The pass would let them through the workshop gate; it was not a travel ticket.
readingBlocks.zh: 开放日一周后，玛雅和乔乘长途汽车来到附近学院。乔安排了参观工程实作室。在接待处，玛雅拿着一夹社区中心的照片。接待员打印访客通行证时，她放下文件夹。这张证让她们通过实作室门禁，并不是车票。

readingBlocks.en:
Receptionist: Please wear your pass where we can see it. The workshop is after the glass doors.
Maya: Shall we wait here?
Receptionist: Dr Chen will come to meet you.
Through the doors, Maya noticed the movement of a trolley across the workshop floor. A student pushed it slowly between the benches.
readingBlocks.zh:
接待员：请把通行证戴在我们看得见的位置。玻璃门后就是实作室。
玛雅：我们在这里等吗？
接待员：陈博士会来接你们。
透过门，玛雅注意到一辆推车穿过实作室地板的移动。一位学生在工作台之间慢慢推着它。

glossary.zh: 拿着；携带（carry 的进行形式）
glossary.note: carry 是动词原形；carrying 是屈折形式，仅计一个携带义单位。
glossary.example: Maya was carrying a folder of photographs.

externalEvidence.definition: move while supporting, either in a vehicle or in one's hands or on one's body

glossary.zh: 准许进入某处的通行证
glossary.note: 可数名词；本例为入场证，不是动词经过或交通月票。

externalEvidence.definition: any authorization to pass or go somewhere

glossary.note: physical movement；不是社会运动或乐章。
glossary.example: The movement of the trolley caught her eye.
glossary.exampleZh: 推车的移动引起她注意。

externalEvidence.definition: the act of changing location from one place to another
